name: MakerMove

sources.title: Homepage — live React app ('The ultimate dashboard of resources for makers & founders'); nav includes Books/Directories/Investors/Tools/Promote/Pro; no server-rendered content
Launch Point Zero profile — submit URL makermove.com/promote, 'Pay to submit: true', ~$9, 'no free option', status active (record updated 2024-09-11)

requirements: Submission route is https://www.makermove.com/promote ('Promote' nav item)
Third-party reporting says submission is paid (~$9) with no free plan — the promote page itself is client-rendered and could not be read directly
Site is a resource dashboard (books, directories, investors, journalists, podcasts, tools) plus a 'Pro' tier
preparation: Payment for the promote fee (~$9 reported; confirm at checkout)
A browser is required — the site is a client-side SPA, so form fields must be inspected live
workflow: Open https://www.makermove.com/promote in a JS-capable browser
Select a promotion package and fill the startup details (description, features, links)
Listing appears within the MakerMove dashboard sections
watchFor: Client-rendered SPA — nothing is verifiable without a browser; current pricing/packages could not be confirmed firsthand
Third-party reviewer rated it 'Should you launch here? No' — decent-looking but unverifiable traffic
Reported price (~$9) dates from Sep 2024 — may have changed
countsAsLive: The product appears in a MakerMove section (e.g. promoted/feature listing) reachable from the live app
unknowns: Current promote pricing and package tiers — page did not render without JavaScript
Traffic volume — could not be verified by third-party review either
